description: Native proxy client for mihomo (Clash.Meta) with TUN, rules and subscriptions
notes: The vendor tarball is used as-is: 'Hop.exe', the bundled mihomo core and helper under 'bin', and the rule databases under 'geodata'.

Settings, subscriptions, logs and the core's cache live in '%APPDATA%\hop'. 'Launch at login' is off by default and only writes a run entry when it is switched on; 'scoop uninstall' removes any run entry that points into the Scoop directory.

Hop checks GitHub for a newer release when it starts and every six hours after that, and shows it in the dashboard. It has no setting to turn that check off and never installs a release without confirmation; updates installed by Scoop replace the files.
Enabling TUN starts Hop's privileged helper, which is installed separately and needs administrator rights.
